privacy.title: What SubHub reads
privacy.readOnly: Read-only access. SubHub never sends, moves or deletes email.
privacy.receiptsOnly: Only messages that look like receipts, invoices or renewal notices are fetched; everything else is skipped at the provider.
privacy.snippets: We keep the vendor, amount, dates and a short text snippet per suggestion — never full message bodies.
privacy.encrypted: OAuth tokens are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM and are deleted when you disconnect.
